question: If perhaps Reinhard obtained the ‘Divine Protection of Becoming Old (in appearance only)’ and became an old man, would Felt’s opinion of Reinhard soften any?
answer: If he was to try turning into an old man as an experiment, it would only be his appearance that became old, so it wouldn’t work. Since only his appearance is old, he wouldn’t give off the old-man pheromones of a true old man who has seen the passage of years. A fake old man would be insufficient to clear the hurdle of Felt-chan’s world-class old-man tastes.
